feed.subtitle: Research papers and global crypto regulation, at a glance
feed.rights: Explanations and summaries are generated by AI from the original text. Dates, rates and amounts are checked against the source, but errors are still possible, so always rely on the original. Nothing here is legal, tax or investment advice.

entry.title: ADGM Publishes Guidance on Crypto Mining Activities
entry.summary: ADGM Becomes the Region's First International Financial Centre to Publish Dedicated Crypto Mining Guidance ADGM / FSRA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Registration Authority of ADGM has published guidance on crypto mining activities within or from the centre. Issued under the Commercial Licensing Regulations 2025, it treats crypto mining as a licensable commercial activity rather than a regulated financial service. The technology-neutral guidance covers Proof-of-Work, Proof-of-Stake and future consensus mechanisms. It is the first phase of the authority's approach, with a regulatory framework to be developed and consulted on later.

entry.title: SFC issues guidance on enhancing Hong Kong's retail fund regime ahead of revised UT Code taking effect 1 November 2026
entry.summary: SFC issues guidance to support enhancements to Hong Kong’s retail fund regime SFC · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Securities and Futures Commission of Hong Kong published guidance to help the fund industry prepare for the revised Code on Unit Trusts and Mutual Funds, which takes effect on 1 November 2026. Key changes include a Value-at-Risk approach to managing funds' derivatives exposure, enhanced liquidity risk management, and stronger investment and disclosure requirements for money market funds. The SFC also published revised key facts statement templates for different fund types to improve transparency.

entry.title: FSA posts agenda for third meeting of Business Accounting Council's sustainability assurance subcommittee on third-party assurance standards
entry.summary: 企業会計審議会第３回サステナビリティ情報保証部会の議事次第について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency published the agenda and materials for the third meeting of the Business Accounting Council's Sustainability Information Assurance Subcommittee, scheduled for October 29, 2026. The secretariat's briefing material is a draft opinion on standards for assurance services, quality management, and ethics and independence for sustainability information. It explains the background, the purpose of third-party assurance, and the proposed nature and names of the standards.

entry.title: FSA recruits a lawyer for monitoring of crypto and fund transfer business compliance
entry.summary: 採用,職員を募集しています。（金融モニタリング業務（資金移動業者や暗号資産交換業者等の法令等遵守態勢、関連法令の解釈等）に従事する職員) 金融庁 · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency announced on October 28, 2026 a recruitment for one lawyer as a fixed-term national civil servant. The role covers monitoring legal compliance of crypto asset exchange and fund transfer businesses, legal interpretation, and developing guidelines. Employment is expected from around January 2027 for about two years, selected by document screening and interview.

entry.title: CFTC to hold a December 15 roundtable on 24/7 trading in derivatives markets
entry.summary: CFTC to Host Roundtable on 24/7 Trading CFTC · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission announced an industry roundtable on December 15 to discuss whether derivatives markets can viably move to 24/7 trading. It builds on the CFTC's earlier summer Request for Comment on the topic. Discussion topics include overnight trading, tokenization, infrastructure, staffing, and operational readiness. The event will be held at CFTC headquarters in Washington and livestreamed on CFTC.gov.

entry.title: NCUA Seeks Public Comment on Draft 2027–2028 Budget
entry.summary: NCUA Draft 2027-2028 Budget Federal Register · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto The National Credit Union Administration published its draft detailed business-type budget for fiscal years 2027 and 2028 for public review, as required by federal statute. The draft covers three components: the Operating Budget, the Capital Budget, and the Share Insurance Fund Administrative Budget. Public comments may be submitted through regulations.gov under docket NCUA–2026–2146 by November 30, 2026, and in-person statements may be presented at a November 17, 2026 budget hearing.

entry.title: VARA Circular on Good Practice for VASP Public Disclosures
entry.summary: Circular: Good practices for VASP’s public disclosures VARA · Oct 28, 2026 · Crypto VARA issued a circular describing good-practice characteristics for public disclosures by licensed Virtual Asset Service Providers, based on its thematic review. It states that disclosure compliance should be an ongoing obligation requiring governance, monitoring and periodic testing rather than a one-time licensing task. The circular is illustrative only and does not modify any Regulations or Rulebooks.

entry.title: FSA announces registration of Kroll Bond Rating Agency Japan as a credit rating agency
entry.summary: 信用格付業者の登録について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto On 27 October 2026, the Financial Services Agency notified Kroll Bond Rating Agency Japan 株式会社 that it had been registered as a credit rating agency (registration number 10). The registration was made under Article 57(3) of the Financial Instruments and Exchange Act, as applied by Article 66-48.

entry.title: Notice on agenda and materials for the Multiple Debt Problem Countermeasures Promotion Advisory Panel
entry.summary: 多重債務問題対策推進懇談会の議事次第等について公表しました。 金融庁 · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto On October 27, 2026, the Financial Services Agency published the agenda and related materials for the Multiple Debt Problem Countermeasures Promotion Advisory Panel. The meeting is scheduled for October 28, 2026 from 14:00 to 15:45 and will discuss the current situation and policy trends for measures against multiple debtors, followed by an exchange of views. The documents include the meeting purpose, member list, operating rules, and related statistics.

entry.title: CFTC and Kansas State University co-host AgCon 2026 agricultural futures conference in Kansas
entry.summary: ICYMI: Agricultural Leaders and Market Participants Join CFTC Chairman Selig in Overland Park, Kansas for AgCon 2026 CFTC · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC and Kansas State University's Risk Management Center co-hosted the two-day 2026 Agricultural Commodity Futures Conference (AgCon) in Overland Park, Kansas. Panels covered the agricultural economy, derivatives market developments, farm credit, and risk management tools for producers. Topics included perpetual futures, 24/7 trading, and tokenized collateral. CFTC Chairman Michael S. Selig attended and delivered the closing remarks.

entry.title: SEC order granting Cboe Clear U.S. temporary registration as a clearing agency for binary options
entry.summary: Cboe Clear U.S., LLC; Order Granting an Application, as Amended, for Temporary Registration as a Clearing Agency Under Section 17A of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 Federal Register · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto The SEC has issued an order granting Cboe Clear U.S., LLC (CCUS) temporary registration as a clearing agency under Section 17A of the Exchange Act. CCUS seeks to provide central counterparty services for binary options that are securities, and filed its application on June 30, 2026, amending it on October 1, 2026. The Commission will consider comments on that amendment before acting on permanent registration.

entry.title: Quarterly notice listing HUD regulatory waivers granted in early 2026
entry.summary: Notice of Regulatory Waiver Requests Granted for the First Quarter of Calendar Year 2026 Federal Register · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto This Federal Register notice from the U.S. Department of Housing and Urban Development lists regulatory waivers HUD approved from January 1 to March 31, 2026, as required by section 106 of the HUD Reform Act of 1989. It explains the legal requirements for waivers, such as written grounds and approval by Assistant Secretary-level officials. entry.title: Notice establishing the Advisory Council on Health and Human Performance Optimization
entry.summary: Establishment of Federal Advisory Committees-Advisory Council on Health and Human Performance Optimization Federal Register · Oct 27, 2026 · Crypto The Department of Defense (referred to as the Department of War) announced in the Federal Register that it is establishing the Advisory Council on Health and Human Performance Optimization as a discretionary federal advisory committee. The notice estimates annual operating costs of $1,368,170, caps membership at 20, and lists the expertise areas from which members will be drawn.

entry.title: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds
entry.summary: SFC approves first-ever secondary trading of tokenised public funds SFC · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The Hong Kong Securities and Futures Commission has approved the world's first secondary trading of tokenised public funds on an SFC-licensed virtual asset trading platform. Two existing SFC-authorised tokenised money market funds can now be traded around the clock. The SFC introduced a framework in April 2026 setting requirements for trading channel operation, fair pricing, liquidity provision and disclosure.

entry.title: Fee schedule amendment updating the definition of “trading platform” (Cboe EDGX, SR-CboeEDGX-2026-072)
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe EDGX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The SEC published a notice of a proposed rule change filed by Cboe EDGX Exchange to amend its fee schedule and update the definition of “trading platform.” The filing was made on October 19, 2026, and is effective upon filing under Rule 19b-4(f)(2). The notice invites public comments, to be submitted on or before November 16, 2026.

entry.title: Cboe BZX proposes updating its fee schedule definition of Trading Platform
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BZX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto Cboe BZX Exchange filed a rule change with the SEC to amend the definition of "Trading Platform" in its fee schedule. The proposal adds a functional, use-based category covering any system through which orders of persons other than the operator are systematically executed electronically. Non-exhaustive examples include a broker crossing system not filed as an ATS, a systematic internalization system, and a decentralized blockchain-based or tokenized environment.

entry.title: Cboe BYX Exchange proposes updating its fee schedule definition of “Trading Platform” (immediately effective)
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe BYX Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing and Immediate Effectiveness of a Proposed Rule Change To Amend Its Fee Schedule To Update the Definition of Trading Platform Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto Cboe BYX Exchange filed a proposed rule change with the Securities and Exchange Commission to update the definition of “Trading Platform” in its fee schedule. The exchange states the change removes duplicative procedural obligations as a UTP trading venue, since the primary listing exchange’s information circular already provides members the same disclosures. The Commission waived the 30-day operative delay, so the change became operative upon filing, and public comments are invited through November 16, 2026.

entry.title: Outbound Investment Security Program Regulations (proposed rule)
entry.summary: Outbound Investment Security Program Regulations Federal Register · Oct 26, 2026 · Crypto The Treasury Department proposes regulations to implement Subtitle C of the Comprehensive Outbound Investment National Security Act, codified in Title VIII of the Defense Production Act. The rule would require U.S. persons to notify Treasury of certain transactions with foreign persons engaged in notifiable technologies, and prohibit certain other transactions with foreign persons engaged in prohibited technologies. It also adds applicability dates so the regulations continue to cover activities within the relevant timeframe. Comments are due December 7, 2026.

entry.title: SEC Releases Fiscal Year 2027 Examination Priorities
entry.summary: SEC Announces Fiscal Year 2027 Examination Priorities SEC · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The SEC announced the Division of Examinations' priorities for fiscal year 2027. The report highlights areas such as investment adviser fiduciary duties, retail investor protection, private funds and private credit, broker-dealer obligations, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies. The priorities are not exhaustive, and the Division may adjust its focus during the year.

entry.title: Self Assessment deadline in 100 days: filing your 2025–26 tax return
entry.summary: Self Assessment deadline incoming – 100 days to go HMRC / gov.uk · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto HM Revenue and Customs (HMRC) urges Self Assessment customers to file their 2025 to 2026 tax return early, with the deadline set for 31 January 2027. Filing early on GOV.UK lets people learn how much tax they owe, budget in advance, get refunds sooner and avoid penalties. The notice also lists available guidance, support tools and warnings about HMRC impersonation scams.

entry.title: Update on Names of Persons Conducting Financial Instruments Business Without Registration (FSA Japan)
entry.summary: その他,無登録で金融商品取引業を行う者の名称等について更新しました。 金融庁 · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The Financial Services Agency (through Finance Bureaus) updated its list of persons who conduct financial instruments business without registration and were issued warning letters, as of October 23, 2026. The list covers domestic and overseas businesses, showing trade names, locations, business content, notes, and publication dates. The FSA notes that listed entities were confirmed as unregistered at the time of the warning, may not reflect current activity, and names or addresses may be outdated. Concerned individuals may contact the FSA consultation desk or the SESC information desk.

entry.title: IRS reminder to plan taxes year-round to make filing easier
entry.summary: IRS reminder: Year-round tax planning can make filing easier IRS · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The IRS encourages taxpayers to take simple steps now, such as checking withholding, organizing records, using IRS online tools, and protecting personal information, to prepare for the 2027 filing season. The attached Publication 5349-A, Year-Round Tax Planning is for Everyone, offers practical tips and IRS resources.

entry.title: UK FCA restricts six unregulated lenders over anti-money laundering control concerns
entry.summary: FCA restricts 6 firms following concerns over anti-money laundering controls FCA · Oct 23, 2026 · Crypto The FCA has placed voluntary restrictions on six Annex 1 firms, unregulated lenders, after raising concerns about their anti-money laundering policies, controls and procedures. The restrictions limit their ability to take on new customers or do new business with existing customers, including extending credit. The FCA is also assessing responses to an information request sent to around 900 registered Annex 1 firms.

entry.title: OCC proposes new information collection for applications to issue payment stablecoins under the GENIUS Act

entry.title: Market integrity in a digital age: FCA chief executive's City Dinner speech
entry.summary: Market integrity in a digital age FCA · Oct 22, 2026 · Crypto Nikhil Rathi, chief executive of the UK Financial Conduct Authority (FCA), delivered this speech at the City of London Corporation's annual City Dinner at Mansion House. He argues that fast technological change brings opportunities but also serious threats to market integrity, including market abuse and financial crime, and that the regulatory system responds too slowly. He says the FCA will make better use of technology and intelligence and use its powers more assertively, and stresses that stronger partnerships between regulators, industry and government are essential.

entry.title: Cboe EDGX proposal to amend Rules 19.3 and 19.4 for listing options on crypto commodity trusts and exchange-traded funds

entry.title: State Justice Institute FY 2027 grant guideline notice

entry.title: Member/Shareholder Notification of Share Insurance (Proposed Rule)

Comments are due by December 21, 2026.

entry.title: Abu Dhabi delegation ends London visit, advancing investment partnerships with UK firms

entry.title: CFTC Secures Court Orders for Former Long Island Resident and Firm to Pay Over $288 Million in Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme
entry.summary: CFTC Secures Federal Court Orders Requiring Former Long Island Resident and His Firm to Pay Over $288 Million for Operating a Commodity Pool Ponzi Scheme CFTC · Oct 19, 2026 · Crypto The CFTC announced that a federal court in the Southern District of New York ordered Eddy Alexandre and his company EminiFX Inc. to pay over $288 million, including $228,576,962 in restitution to defrauded investors, $15,049,500 in disgorgement of unlawful gains, and a $45,148,500 civil penalty. The order states EminiFX posed as an investment club promising weekly returns of 5% to 9.99% and was a Ponzi scheme. As of July 2026, over $98 million had been returned to more than 28,000 investors.

entry.title: SEC Approves Cboe Proposal to List Binary Options on Issuer Key Performance Indicators
entry.summary: Self-Regulatory Organizations; Cboe Exchange, Inc.; Notice of Filing of Amendment No. 1 and Order Granting Accelerated Approval of a Proposed Rule Change, as Modified by Amendment No. 1, To Permit the Listing of Binary Options Overlying Key Performance Indicators Reported by Certain Issuers of Stock Federal Register · Oct 16, 2026 · Crypto The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission published a notice and order concerning a rule change filed by Cboe Exchange, Inc. entry.title: ESMA's third sanctions report calls for more consistent enforcement across the EU
entry.summary: ESMA's third Sanctions Report highlights the need for greater convergence in enforcement ESMA · Oct 15, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has published its consolidated report on sanctions and measures imposed across the EEA in 2025. National authorities imposed more than 950 administrative sanctions and measures, with administrative fines totaling almost €82 million, and settlements were used more often. The report finds significant differences in enforcement and says ESMA will foster exchanges among national authorities so similar breaches lead to similar outcomes.

entry.title: ESMA updates transparency manual with guidance on OTC derivatives and tick-size regime
entry.summary: ESMA updates its manual on transparency with new guidance for OTC derivatives and tick-size regime ESMA · Oct 15, 2026 · Crypto The European Securities and Markets Authority (ESMA) has updated its manual on pre- and post-trade transparency under MiFID II/MiFIR. The update clarifies which over-the-counter derivatives are subject to transparency requirements, how their identifying reference data should be provided, and adds Q&As and recommendations on the tick-size regime. The updated manual is to be considered a draft until the related technical standards (RTS 2 and the RTS on CTP input/output data) enter into force.

entry.title: Proposed Amendments to Investment Company Cross Trading Rule
entry.summary: Investment Company Cross Trading Federal Register · Oct 15, 2026 · Crypto The SEC proposes amending rule 17a-7 under the Investment Company Act, which permits certain cross trades between registered funds and affiliates subject to conditions. The amendments would expand eligible securities, modernize the rule's conditions, and enhance investor protection. The proposal also requires aggregated reporting of trading activity and cross trades on Form N-PORT and Form N-MFP. Comments are due December 14, 2026.

entry.title: HKMA welcomes launch of Chongqing-Hong Kong cross-boundary data validation platform for secure data checks without moving original documents
entry.summary: HKMA welcomes launch of Chongqing-Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform HKMA · Oct 14, 2026 · Crypto On 14 October 2026, Chongqing and Hong Kong authorities launched the Chongqing-Hong Kong Cross-boundary Data Validation Platform (CQ-HK DVP), which uses blockchain technology and hash values to verify customer-submitted data without transferring or storing original documents across the border. The platform will initially support cross-boundary financial use cases, such as account opening and loan applications, building on the Shenzhen-Hong Kong platform.
